title: Legends of Japan with Hiroshima
alt: The floating torii gate at Miyajima, Japan
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Well placed hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station and Hakone
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: Up to the fifth station on Mount Fuji, then Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with a full city day, a Mount Fuji and Hakone day and a free day for the neighbourhoods.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Miyajima
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel attached to Hiroshima station

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima tour
activities.description: The Peace Memorial Park and museum in the morning, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: Two nights beside the station, with a day that pairs the Peace Memorial Park with the island shrine at Miyajima.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel one stop from Namba, in central Osaka

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, with a buffet lunch and coach travel from Namba.

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights to finish, with Kyoto and Nara, a walking tour of the food streets and a free day before you fly home.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Adding Hiroshima and Miyajima is what turns a Japan holiday into the trip people talk about years later.
expert.tip: Two free days are deliberate. Japan is tiring in the best way, and the Shinkansen means you can still add Nikko or Himeji on a whim.

summary: Eleven days from Tokyo to Kansai: four nights in Shinjuku with a city day and Mount Fuji, two in Hiroshima for the Peace Memorial Park and the floating torii gate at Miyajima, then four in Osaka with Kyoto, Nara and a walking tour.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train between Tokyo, Hiroshima and Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; Hiroshima and Miyajima tour; Kyoto and Nara day trip with buffet lunch; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
